article_title: Over 1,000 tonnes of sewage seen at Doncaster landfill site

tasks.prompt: What is the main focus of the article?
options: Concerns about sewage sludge, odour and site management at a landfill near Doncaster are being investigated by the Environment Agency.
A new airport is being built inside a former quarry near Doncaster.
The Environment Agency has permanently closed every waste site in Yorkshire.
A motocross company has bought the Finningley landfill.
tasks.correct_answer: Concerns about sewage sludge, odour and site management at a landfill near Doncaster are being investigated by the Environment Agency.
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הכתבה עוסקת בחששות מפסולת ביוב, ריחות וניהול אתר ההטמנה בפינינגלי ובצעדים שדורשת הסוכנות להגנת הסביבה.

tasks.prompt: What did Environment Agency officers observe during their visit?
options: An empty quarry with no waste
About 1,000 tonnes of sewage sludge stored outside in an uncovered pile
A completed airport runway
A new indoor recycling centre
tasks.correct_answer: About 1,000 tonnes of sewage sludge stored outside in an uncovered pile
tasks.explanation_hebrew: לפי המידע שנמסר לחבר הפרלמנט, נצפו כ־1,000 טונות של בוצת ביוב באחסון חיצוני בערימה לא מכוסה.

tasks.prompt: What does “stockpile” mean in the article?
options: A written list of environmental rules
A vehicle used at a landfill
A large quantity collected and stored together
A fine imposed by the Environment Agency
tasks.correct_answer: A large quantity collected and stored together
tasks.explanation_hebrew: Stockpile היא כמות גדולה של חומר שנאספה ונשמרה יחד, כאן ערימה של בוצת ביוב.

tasks.prompt: By what date was the operator told to resolve the issue?
options: 9 October
26 October
Tuesday
10 November
tasks.explanation_hebrew: חבר הפרלמנט אמר שהסוכנות נתנה למפעיל האתר עד 10 בנובמבר לפתור את הבעיה.

tasks.prompt: Why did the neighbouring motocross track close?
options: People reported headaches, nausea and feeling unwell, which they blamed on smells from the site.
The track was converted into a landfill.
Its riders moved to another country.
The Environment Agency bought the business.
tasks.correct_answer: People reported headaches, nausea and feeling unwell, which they blamed on smells from the site.
tasks.explanation_hebrew: המסלול נסגר לאחר שמבקרים דיווחו על כאבי ראש, בחילה ותחושה רעה שיוחסו לריחות מהאתר הסמוך.

tasks.prompt: What does “ramifications” mean in the phrase “environmental ramifications”?
options: Official photographs
Possible consequences or effects
Waste containers
Approved operating documents
tasks.explanation_hebrew: Ramifications פירושה השלכות או תוצאות אפשריות, במקרה זה על הסביבה ואיכות האוויר.

tasks.prompt: Besides the uncovered sewage sludge, describe two other concerns raised about the site.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לציין שני חששות מדויקים מן הכתבה.
expected_points: Whether activities matched the approved operating techniques and management arrangements.
Potential asbestos disposal at the site.
Possible effects on air quality and the environment.
Odours that nearby staff and visitors said caused headaches, nausea and illness.

tasks.prompt: Why could the landfill issue have economic effects beyond the site itself?
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש להסביר כיצד הבעיה משפיעה על עסק שכן ועל יכולתו לפעול.
expected_points: The neighbouring motocross venue closed because it said it could not operate safely amid the odours.
The closure has caused serious financial consequences for Doncaster Moto Parc.
Its director said the business may no longer be viable and could be lost altogether.
Staff, customers and local activity are affected even though they do not operate the landfill.

tasks.prompt: Summarise the concerns, investigation and response in 3–4 sentences.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לכלול את הכמות שנצפתה, בדיקת הסוכנות, מועד התיקון והשפעת הריחות.
expected_points: An MP said about 1,000 tonnes of sewage sludge were stored uncovered at a landfill near Doncaster.
The Environment Agency inspected the site and raised concerns about management and operating practices.
It gave the operator until 10 November to address the issue and said further enforcement action was possible.
A neighbouring motocross venue closed after people reported illness linked to odours.

tasks.prompt: Write a short factual update for local residents about the Environment Agency's response.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לנסח עדכון ברור ומאוזן, להבחין בין טענות לממצאים מאושרים ולא להמציא סיכון בריאותי.
expected_points: State that the Environment Agency inspected the site.
Mention the observed uncovered sludge and identified odour-management issues.
Say the operator was given actions to complete and a 10 November deadline.
Note that further enforcement may follow if required.
Attribute health complaints to the people who reported them rather than presenting causation as proven.
